law.catch_line: Occupation of trailer being towed on highways
law.text: No person shall occupy a house trailer or camping trailer while it is being towed on a public highway in this Commonwealth. No operator of a towing vehicle shall knowingly permit another person to occupy a house trailer or camping trailer as defined in § 46.2-100 while it is being towed. In any civil proceeding, the violation of this section shall not constitute negligence per se.
